---- MODULE ConfigParamsLLM ----

CONSTANTS MyInt, MyStr, MyModelValue1, MyModelValue2, MySet

VARIABLES x, y, z, w

Init == x = MyInt
  /\ y = MyStr
  /\ z = MyModelValue1
  /\ w = MySet

Next == x' = x
  /\ y' = y
  /\ z' = z
  /\ w' = w

Inv == x = 42
  /\ y = "hello"
  /\ z = MyModelValue1
  /\ z \in MyModelValue2
  /\ w = {1, 2, 3}

---- END MODULE ConfigParamsLLM ----
